language: Iraqi Arabic (ar-IQ), with a few mixed Arabic/English inputs
source: AI-authored by the ChatGPT coding assistant from the public mock-wallet schema and explicit edge-case requirements; no real customer data
change_history: v1: 72 cases / 78 turns. v2 appends two cases for ledger-grounded insights and an unsent support form; existing case IDs, inputs and labels are unchanged.
label_basis: Expected structured outcome, recipient and IQD integer amount are authored from the seeded synthetic fixtures. Labels are not inferred from current implementation output.
generation_brief: Create realistic synthetic Iraqi-Arabic wallet requests spanning reads, saved transfers, saved bills, missing or ambiguous details, multi-turn clarification, monthly reminder forms, and adversarial or malformed requests. Include duplicate Ali contacts, negative and fractional amounts, multiple payment intents, negation, unknown billers, chat confirmation, account-switch instructions and secrets. Use only the fictional profiles and records in docs/DEMO_DATA.md. Keep ledger delta zero because the benchmark never presses Confirm.
limitations: These cases are visible during development and may guide fixes; they cannot support an unbiased held-out accuracy claim.
A native Iraqi Arabic reviewer has not edited or approved these requests or labels.
Structured matching does not grade the quality, tone, factual accuracy or clarity of generated prose.
This benchmark covers request-to-review or safe-response behavior, not complete payment execution or Android device usability.
next_step: Have native Iraqi speakers edit at least 50 requests, separately freeze a fresh evaluation set with its hash and labels, and record model, commit, date, category denominators, failures and actual user observations.
